name: Model Viewer
description: Developer tool for new creature models: model_viewer.show <template guid> [ahead] [right] spawns it in front of the camera as an ally that stays with you; foe spawns a creature as it is; attack sends the allies at the last foe; hurt brings the last foe down to a percent; status shows their health; near lists creatures around you (health, level, scale, base health); push moves one with the game's teleport; god keeps you alive; clear removes them. Host only; nothing is saved.
